summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus _resolve_path helper, imports only json, os, typing), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Verified by reading only: no added line exceeds 120 columns. Tests were not run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. Choices: a missing or non-list key value and a non-object top-level JSON both raise ValueError; JSON decode errors propagate as ValueError subclasses; empty path lists are allowed; no extra error-path tests were added.
